People's Budget Coalition Co-convenor Adolfo Jose Montesa
segments.text: Good afternoon, Madam Chair, Senator Hontiveros, DNR officials, and to our colleagues from Civil Society.

segments.speaker: People's Budget Coalition Co-convenor Adolfo Jose Montesa
segments.text: On behalf of the People's Budget Coalition,

segments.speaker: People's Budget Coalition Co-convenor Adolfo Jose Montesa
segments.text: Ken Amante and myself, I would like to thank you, Sen. Teresa, for inviting us as resource persons.

segments.speaker: People's Budget Coalition Co-convenor Adolfo Jose Montesa
segments.text: I think we do need to acknowledge that this is a huge step.

segments.speaker: People's Budget Coalition Co-convenor Adolfo Jose Montesa
segments.text: This is the first time that civil society is being invited to a department budget hearing in at least 10 years.

segments.speaker: People's Budget Coalition Co-convenor Adolfo Jose Montesa
segments.text: So we really do acknowledge how important this proceeding is for us and for restoring trust in the entire budget process after the damage that was done in the previous scandals.

segments.speaker: People's Budget Coalition Co-convenor Adolfo Jose Montesa
segments.text: For the DNR budget, we believe that there is no shortage.

segments.speaker: People's Budget Coalition Co-convenor Adolfo Jose Montesa
segments.text: There is no such thing as a natural disaster.

segments.speaker: People's Budget Coalition Co-convenor Adolfo Jose Montesa
People's Budget Coalition Co-convenor Adolfo Jose Montesa
segments.text: Failures in planning, coordination, enforcement, and watershed protection make things worse.

segments.speaker: People's Budget Coalition Co-convenor Adolfo Jose Montesa
segments.text: And the flood control scandal of the last years showed billions of pesos spent on infrastructure while communities remain dangerously vulnerable.

segments.speaker: People's Budget Coalition Co-convenor Adolfo Jose Montesa
segments.text: So we look to the DNR.

segments.speaker: People's Budget Coalition Co-convenor Adolfo Jose Montesa
segments.text: We expect an agency that will protect our watersheds, enforce environmental laws, scrutinize development projects,

segments.speaker: People's Budget Coalition Co-convenor Adolfo Jose Montesa
segments.text: and ensure that government investments do not aggravate

segments.speaker: People's Budget Coalition Co-convenor Adolfo Jose Montesa
segments.text: the very disasters that they are supposed to prevent. Our assessment is that the current version of the DNR budget will not adequately prepare us for typhoons, flooding, urban heat, and the extreme weather conditions worsened by the strong El Nino.

segments.speaker: People's Budget Coalition Co-convenor Adolfo Jose Montesa
segments.text: The budget of the DNR Office of the Secretary has been stuck at 16 to 20 billion pesos since 2018.

segments.speaker: People's Budget Coalition Co-convenor Adolfo Jose Montesa
segments.text: And accounting for inflation over the last 10 years, and even the recent depreciation of the peso and oil price hikes,

segments.speaker: People's Budget Coalition Co-convenor Adolfo Jose Montesa
segments.text: this means that the real budget...

segments.speaker: People's Budget Coalition Co-convenor Adolfo Jose Montesa
segments.text: of the department has fallen by about 30% in real terms.

segments.speaker: People's Budget Coalition Co-convenor Adolfo Jose Montesa
segments.text: Capital outlays fell from 37% in 2018 to just 12% for this coming year.

segments.speaker: People's Budget Coalition Co-convenor Adolfo Jose Montesa
segments.text: And 1.8 billion pesos was left unobligated in 2025.

segments.speaker: People's Budget Coalition Co-convenor Adolfo Jose Montesa
segments.text: In the 2027 proposal, the Environmental Management Bureau, or EMB,

segments.speaker: People's Budget Coalition Co-convenor Adolfo Jose Montesa
segments.text: which issues and monitors environmental compliance certificates,

segments.speaker: People's Budget Coalition Co-convenor Adolfo Jose Montesa
segments.text: is the only attached bureau that was cut or reduced by 360 million pesos.

segments.speaker: People's Budget Coalition Co-convenor Adolfo Jose Montesa
segments.text: So we want a stronger DNR that...

segments.speaker: People's Budget Coalition Co-convenor Adolfo Jose Montesa
segments.text: enforces our environmental laws to prevent these disasters.

segments.speaker: People's Budget Coalition Co-convenor Adolfo Jose Montesa
segments.text: But a bigger budget will not necessarily make communities safer

segments.speaker: People's Budget Coalition Co-convenor Adolfo Jose Montesa
segments.text: if the DNR keeps approving projects without studying these projects comprehensively.

segments.speaker: People's Budget Coalition Co-convenor Adolfo Jose Montesa
segments.text: To be frank, our civil society movements are very concerned

segments.speaker: People's Budget Coalition Co-convenor Adolfo Jose Montesa
segments.text: that DNR too often acts as a rubber stamp in its environmental impact assessment procedures.

segments.speaker: People's Budget Coalition Co-convenor Adolfo Jose Montesa
segments.text: Feedback on the ground has been that the department proposes certifications and approvals

segments.speaker: People's Budget Coalition Co-convenor Adolfo Jose Montesa
segments.text: without sufficiently accounting for the impact of the environmental impact.

segments.speaker: People's Budget Coalition Co-convenor Adolfo Jose Montesa
segments.text: So we need an agency that anticipates harm and not just one that merely responds

segments.speaker: People's Budget Coalition Co-convenor Adolfo Jose Montesa
segments.text: after the damage has already been done.

segments.speaker: People's Budget Coalition Co-convenor Adolfo Jose Montesa
segments.text: So we illustrate three systemic issues using three cases.

segments.speaker: People's Budget Coalition Co-convenor Adolfo Jose Montesa
Senator Risa Hontiveros
segments.text: Either enumerate the three or detail one, please.

segments.speaker: People's Budget Coalition Co-convenor Adolfo Jose Montesa
People's Budget Coalition Co-convenor Adolfo Jose Montesa
segments.text: The first one is the environmental clearance of expressway projects,

segments.speaker: People's Budget Coalition Co-convenor Adolfo Jose Montesa
People's Budget Coalition Co-convenor Adolfo Jose Montesa
segments.text: which is San Miguel's 40.65-kilometer Southern Access Link Expressway

segments.speaker: People's Budget Coalition Co-convenor Adolfo Jose Montesa
segments.text: na sasagasa sa mga puno, kalikasan, paaralan, ospital, negosyo at heritage

segments.speaker: People's Budget Coalition Co-convenor Adolfo Jose Montesa
segments.text: sa Quirina Rojas Boulevard, Padre Faura, Buendia, C3R10, and Shoreline Expressway.

segments.speaker: People's Budget Coalition Co-convenor Adolfo Jose Montesa
segments.text: The different civil society movements like Stop SALEX and Ilog Pasiglahin movements

segments.speaker: People's Budget Coalition Co-convenor Adolfo Jose Montesa
segments.text: have pointed out the bad impacts of elevated expressways

segments.speaker: People's Budget Coalition Co-convenor Adolfo Jose Montesa
segments.text: on health, traffic, heritage, environment, and economy.

segments.speaker: People's Budget Coalition Co-convenor Adolfo Jose Montesa
segments.text: So we ask, why is the DENR approving elevated expressways

segments.speaker: People's Budget Coalition Co-convenor Adolfo Jose Montesa
segments.text: even when the most progressive cities in the world are tearing them down?

segments.speaker: People's Budget Coalition Co-convenor Adolfo Jose Montesa
segments.text: So ang tanong po namin, why did the construction of a 40-kilometer expressway

segments.speaker: People's Budget Coalition Co-convenor Adolfo Jose Montesa
segments.text: proceed without a full environmental impact assessment?

segments.speaker: People's Budget Coalition Co-convenor Adolfo Jose Montesa
segments.text: Why did it proceed with only three initial environmental examination checklists

segments.speaker: People's Budget Coalition Co-convenor Adolfo Jose Montesa
segments.text: covering a total of only 13 kilometers?

segments.speaker: People's Budget Coalition Co-convenor Adolfo Jose Montesa
segments.text: I think for the other two issues, I think my colleague Ken will just briefly touch on them po.

segments.speaker: Senator Risa Hontiveros
segments.text: AJ, yes, Ken Abante from People's Budget Coalition. Briefly, please.

People's Budget Coalition Co-convenor Kenneth Isaiah Ibasco Abante
segments.text: Yung pangalawang karanasan po na gusto namin i-share ay sa tingin po namin napakahalaga

segments.speaker: People's Budget Coalition Co-convenor Kenneth Isaiah Ibasco Abante
segments.text: para po sa preparation natin sa El Ni?o at pagbaha.

segments.speaker: People's Budget Coalition Co-convenor Kenneth Isaiah Ibasco Abante
segments.text: Ito po yung karanasan sa sistema ng watershed restoration.

segments.speaker: People's Budget Coalition Co-convenor Kenneth Isaiah Ibasco Abante
segments.text: Yung Upper Marikina Basin Protected Landscape covering 26,000 hectares in Rizal

segments.speaker: People's Budget Coalition Co-convenor Kenneth Isaiah Ibasco Abante
segments.text: ay protection po natin sa matinding pagbaha at tagtuyot sa buong Kamainilaan.

segments.speaker: People's Budget Coalition Co-convenor Kenneth Isaiah Ibasco Abante
segments.text: Pero po, despite its protected status, the watershed remains severely

segments.speaker: People's Budget Coalition Co-convenor Kenneth Isaiah Ibasco Abante
People's Budget Coalition Co-convenor Kenneth Isaiah Ibasco Abante
segments.text: Yung forest cover po nito ay 25% na lamang against DENR's restoration target of 43% by 2028,

segments.speaker: People's Budget Coalition Co-convenor Kenneth Isaiah Ibasco Abante
segments.text: which we believe to still be too low.

segments.speaker: People's Budget Coalition Co-convenor Kenneth Isaiah Ibasco Abante
segments.text: Dapat 72% to 90% ayon sa isang 2018 World Bank DENR study.

segments.speaker: People's Budget Coalition Co-convenor Kenneth Isaiah Ibasco Abante
segments.text: The higher the forest cover, the greater the water and disaster resilience benefits versus river runoffs.

segments.speaker: People's Budget Coalition Co-convenor Kenneth Isaiah Ibasco Abante
segments.text: Ang status po ng restoration, 1,500 of these 26,000 hectares are in danger of incursion

segments.speaker: People's Budget Coalition Co-convenor Kenneth Isaiah Ibasco Abante
segments.text: 2 major projects need urgent review and finalization by the DENR.

segments.speaker: People's Budget Coalition Co-convenor Kenneth Isaiah Ibasco Abante
segments.text: Ang una, si Rapid City at sister company nitong Quarry Rock

segments.speaker: People's Budget Coalition Co-convenor Kenneth Isaiah Ibasco Abante
segments.text: ay may quarrying projects na kinansinalanan ng DENR noong 2022.

segments.speaker: People's Budget Coalition Co-convenor Kenneth Isaiah Ibasco Abante
People's Budget Coalition Co-convenor Kenneth Isaiah Ibasco Abante
segments.text: Pero hindi pa rin po finalized ang desisyon

segments.speaker: People's Budget Coalition Co-convenor Kenneth Isaiah Ibasco Abante
segments.text: sa kanilang motion for consideration, which potentially impacts 985 hectares.

segments.speaker: People's Budget Coalition Co-convenor Kenneth Isaiah Ibasco Abante
segments.text: Ang pangalawang proyekto po ay ang VINA Energy na may application naman

segments.speaker: People's Budget Coalition Co-convenor Kenneth Isaiah Ibasco Abante
segments.text: para sa isang 553 hectares na special use agreement in protected areas or SAPA

segments.speaker: People's Budget Coalition Co-convenor Kenneth Isaiah Ibasco Abante
segments.text: at pending pa rin po ito sa DNR.

segments.speaker: People's Budget Coalition Co-convenor Kenneth Isaiah Ibasco Abante
segments.text: At may formal opposition na po dito ang Upper Marikina Watershed.

segments.speaker: People's Budget Coalition Co-convenor Kenneth Isaiah Ibasco Abante
segments.text: So we hope, isa lang pong kaso ang Upper Marikina Watershed.

segments.speaker: People's Budget Coalition Co-convenor Kenneth Isaiah Ibasco Abante
segments.text: We think this has to be one of the core issues that are discussed by the committee

segments.speaker: People's Budget Coalition Co-convenor Kenneth Isaiah Ibasco Abante
segments.text: and also in the plenary because we want prevention, not just damage control.

segments.speaker: People's Budget Coalition Co-convenor Kenneth Isaiah Ibasco Abante
segments.text: And we also ask DNR to account for all the other watersheds in the country

segments.speaker: People's Budget Coalition Co-convenor Kenneth Isaiah Ibasco Abante
segments.text: because we are hearing from different civil society groups that this is also the case.

segments.speaker: People's Budget Coalition Co-convenor Kenneth Isaiah Ibasco Abante
segments.text: And finally po, we think that DNR has a responsibility to also stop the flood control scandal.

segments.speaker: People's Budget Coalition Co-convenor Kenneth Isaiah Ibasco Abante
segments.text: Ayon po sa isang Action Klima Report, only 0.1% of the national budget

People's Budget Coalition Co-convenor Kenneth Isaiah Ibasco Abante
segments.text: Karamihan po nang natag sa climate budget ay puro mga DPWH gray infrastructure.

segments.speaker: People's Budget Coalition Co-convenor Kenneth Isaiah Ibasco Abante
segments.text: So we ask the DENR to please help us review the 7,054 projects worth 190 billion pesos

segments.speaker: People's Budget Coalition Co-convenor Kenneth Isaiah Ibasco Abante
segments.text: that we tagged were inserted by the House of Representatives without proper documentation.

segments.speaker: People's Budget Coalition Co-convenor Kenneth Isaiah Ibasco Abante
segments.text: We ask for the Senate's help on this.

segments.speaker: People's Budget Coalition Co-convenor Kenneth Isaiah Ibasco Abante
segments.text: We have the list. We have the maps.

segments.speaker: People's Budget Coalition Co-convenor Kenneth Isaiah Ibasco Abante
segments.text: We are seeing many projects in many different areas.

segments.speaker: People's Budget Coalition Co-convenor Kenneth Isaiah Ibasco Abante
segments.text: That were inserted by the House without proper documentation.

segments.speaker: People's Budget Coalition Co-convenor Kenneth Isaiah Ibasco Abante
segments.text: Please DNR, please help us make sure that these projects are proper.

segments.speaker: People's Budget Coalition Co-convenor Kenneth Isaiah Ibasco Abante
segments.text: And just to summarize po, we hope that the committee supports us in the review of these expressway projects

segments.speaker: People's Budget Coalition Co-convenor Kenneth Isaiah Ibasco Abante
segments.text: and the incursions in the Upper Marikina Watershed and other watersheds

segments.speaker: People's Budget Coalition Co-convenor Kenneth Isaiah Ibasco Abante
segments.text: to publish the status and work with us on verifying all of these maps

segments.speaker: People's Budget Coalition Co-convenor Kenneth Isaiah Ibasco Abante
segments.text: and making sure that the scientific community is really part of the process,

segments.speaker: People's Budget Coalition Co-convenor Kenneth Isaiah Ibasco Abante
People's Budget Coalition Co-convenor Kenneth Isaiah Ibasco Abante
People's Budget Coalition Co-convenor Kenneth Isaiah Ibasco Abante
segments.text: Hindi na po natutulog ang aming mga angry nerds.

segments.speaker: People's Budget Coalition Co-convenor Kenneth Isaiah Ibasco Abante
segments.text: So pag-check po ng 18,000 projects that were passed by the House.

segments.speaker: People's Budget Coalition Co-convenor Kenneth Isaiah Ibasco Abante
segments.text: And we are committed, Senator Riza and Secretary Cuna,

segments.speaker: People's Budget Coalition Co-convenor Kenneth Isaiah Ibasco Abante
segments.text: to work with you on guarding our public money.

segments.speaker: People's Budget Coalition Co-convenor Kenneth Isaiah Ibasco Abante
Senator Risa Hontiveros
segments.text: Ken Abante also from the People's Budget Coalition.

segments.speaker: Senator Risa Hontiveros
segments.text: Very well noted yung mga initial na follow-up questions or points that you have raised.

segments.speaker: Senator Risa Hontiveros
segments.text: And gaya ng sinabi ko rin kay Mr. Aparente,

segments.speaker: Senator Risa Hontiveros
segments.text: asahan po namin ang subcommittee in partnership sa DNR

segments.speaker: Senator Risa Hontiveros
segments.text: yung patuloy niyong engage sa amin papunta sa plenary.

segments.speaker: Senator Risa Hontiveros
segments.text: Both for additional questions tulad ng dinagdag niyo ngayong hapon

segments.speaker: Senator Risa Hontiveros
segments.text: I think very exciting yung possibilities dito.

segments.speaker: Senator Risa Hontiveros
segments.text: So I would like to thank, marami salamat po ang DNR at ang attached agency sa pagpresenta nyo ng budget para sa 2027.

segments.speaker: Senator Risa Hontiveros
segments.text: Important issues ang nag-surface kasama na yung kakulangan ng paghahanda natin sa dumating na at tumitindi pang Super El Nino.

segments.speaker: Senator Risa Hontiveros
segments.text: Asahan po ninyo na makikipagrabaho ang subcommittee sa department

segments.speaker: Senator Risa Hontiveros
segments.text: at saka sa finance committee chair para i-transform yung DNR budget sa isang El Nino ready budget

segments.speaker: Senator Risa Hontiveros
segments.text: para ma-mitigate yung negatibong epekto sa ating kalikasan at sa ating mga kababayan.

segments.speaker: People's Budget Coalition Co-convenor Kenneth Isaiah Ibasco Abante
People's Budget Coalition Co-convenor Kenneth Isaiah Ibasco Abante
segments.text: Ay ma'am, sorry. There was another...

segments.speaker: Senator Risa Hontiveros
segments.text: You should have said so earlier. That's what your mic is for.

segments.speaker: Senator Risa Hontiveros
segments.text: Briefly na lang please, Ms. Eunice of the Mangrove Breakthrough.

segments.speaker: Mangrove Breakthrough Southeast Asia Manager Eunice Tanilon
Mangrove Breakthrough Southeast Asia Manager Eunice Tanilon
Mangrove Breakthrough Southeast Asia Manager Eunice Tanilon
Mangrove Breakthrough Southeast Asia Manager Eunice Tanilon
segments.text: So I think our colleagues at the PBC have already talked about the upstream issues on watershed management.

segments.speaker: Mangrove Breakthrough Southeast Asia Manager Eunice Tanilon
segments.text: I'd like to focus on downstream to coastal communities.

segments.speaker: Mangrove Breakthrough Southeast Asia Manager Eunice Tanilon
Mangrove Breakthrough Southeast Asia Manager Eunice Tanilon
segments.text: Thank you so much to the subcommittee, Secretary Kuna, and our colleagues from DNR.

segments.speaker: Mangrove Breakthrough Southeast Asia Manager Eunice Tanilon
segments.text: I'm Eunice Tanilon of the Mangrove Breakthrough, a global partnership of government, scientists, and investors

segments.speaker: Mangrove Breakthrough Southeast Asia Manager Eunice Tanilon
segments.text: working to secure the world's mangroves by 2030.

segments.speaker: Mangrove Breakthrough Southeast Asia Manager Eunice Tanilon
segments.text: Our partner is the Global Mangrove Alliance Philippines, comprised of key conservation organizations.

segments.speaker: Mangrove Breakthrough Southeast Asia Manager Eunice Tanilon
segments.text: We work together with the DNR and the National Blue Carbon Action Partnership.

segments.speaker: Mangrove Breakthrough Southeast Asia Manager Eunice Tanilon
segments.text: So it's essentially a roadmap for five years on how to restore our key mangrove priority landscapes.

segments.speaker: Mangrove Breakthrough Southeast Asia Manager Eunice Tanilon
segments.text: So I think what I want to talk about this afternoon is to really just...

segments.speaker: Mangrove Breakthrough Southeast Asia Manager Eunice Tanilon
segments.text: how difficult it's been to put together financing and money for the very large-scale coordination that's needed

segments.speaker: Mangrove Breakthrough Southeast Asia Manager Eunice Tanilon
Senator Risa Hontiveros
segments.text: Kasi may pagkakataon pa tayo na mag-usap at makipagtrabaho.

segments.speaker: Mangrove Breakthrough Southeast Asia Manager Eunice Tanilon
segments.text: I think to jump straight to our recommendations, we really hope that the DNR could fund,

segments.speaker: Mangrove Breakthrough Southeast Asia Manager Eunice Tanilon
segments.text: and of course the committee could fund the foundations,

segments.speaker: Mangrove Breakthrough Southeast Asia Manager Eunice Tanilon
segments.text: and put a date on protocol.

segments.speaker: Mangrove Breakthrough Southeast Asia Manager Eunice Tanilon
segments.text: So we would really like a national carbon stock assessment carried out with our universities,

segments.speaker: Mangrove Breakthrough Southeast Asia Manager Eunice Tanilon
Mangrove Breakthrough Southeast Asia Manager Eunice Tanilon
segments.text: and a commitment that a blue carbon quantification protocol will be issued as a department order

segments.speaker: Mangrove Breakthrough Southeast Asia Manager Eunice Tanilon
segments.text: by the end of the first quarter of 2027.

segments.speaker: Mangrove Breakthrough Southeast Asia Manager Eunice Tanilon
segments.text: This has been the key item that's been blocking all of our conversations with investors.

segments.speaker: Mangrove Breakthrough Southeast Asia Manager Eunice Tanilon
segments.text: We've been in conversations with ADB, AIIB, and also other banks in Singapore.

segments.speaker: Mangrove Breakthrough Southeast Asia Manager Eunice Tanilon
Mangrove Breakthrough Southeast Asia Manager Eunice Tanilon
segments.text: a lot of our conversations stalled because of the lack of these foundational items.

segments.speaker: Mangrove Breakthrough Southeast Asia Manager Eunice Tanilon
segments.text: And secondly, we hope that a special provision in the DNR budget that accounts for blue carbon

segments.speaker: Mangrove Breakthrough Southeast Asia Manager Eunice Tanilon
segments.text: separately from forest carbon requires the department to designate within 90 days

segments.speaker: Mangrove Breakthrough Southeast Asia Manager Eunice Tanilon
segments.text: the bureau accountable for mangroves inside and outside protected areas

segments.speaker: Mangrove Breakthrough Southeast Asia Manager Eunice Tanilon
segments.text: and requires an annual public hectare count against the PSA mangrove accounts.

segments.speaker: Mangrove Breakthrough Southeast Asia Manager Eunice Tanilon
segments.text: So we really hope with this that it gives every loan, grant, and private peso

segments.speaker: Mangrove Breakthrough Southeast Asia Manager Eunice Tanilon
segments.text: a public share to match against.

segments.speaker: Mangrove Breakthrough Southeast Asia Manager Eunice Tanilon
segments.text: So we're very willing to help the Mangrove Breakthrough and Global Mangrove Alliance on these items.

segments.speaker: Mangrove Breakthrough Southeast Asia Manager Eunice Tanilon
Senator Risa Hontiveros
segments.text: Thank you very much too, Mangrove Breakthrough.

segments.speaker: Senator Risa Hontiveros
segments.text: Yung blue carbon niyo very interesting kasi dinidinig nga namin yung blue economy bill

segments.speaker: Senator Risa Hontiveros
segments.text: And special provision, we love special provisions in the budget.

segments.speaker: Senator Risa Hontiveros
segments.text: Platform towards making them regular line items in the following year's budget.

segments.speaker: Senator Risa Hontiveros
segments.text: I really share the excitement to, sabi ko nga kay SEC nung briefings namin,

segments.speaker: Senator Risa Hontiveros
segments.text: to raise the profile of the department strategically in the years ahead.

segments.speaker: Senator Risa Hontiveros
segments.text: Starting, continuing now, especially dito sa panahon ng Super El Nino.

segments.speaker: Senator Risa Hontiveros
segments.text: And for the department to have more naman than 1% of the budget.

segments.speaker: Senator Risa Hontiveros
segments.text: 0.1, oh my God, okay, 0.1% of the budget and to spend it optimally.

segments.speaker: Senator Risa Hontiveros
segments.text: Anyway, so to continue, I was just going to close our hearing for today.

segments.speaker: Senator Risa Hontiveros
segments.text: So yun, seryoso yung i-consider din namin yung inputs mula sa CSO partners

segments.speaker: Senator Risa Hontiveros
segments.text: sa transformation ito ng DNR budget.

segments.speaker: Senator Risa Hontiveros
segments.text: So, sa ganyan, gusto kong formal na i-endorse yung budget ng DNR sa plenary.

segments.speaker: Senator Risa Hontiveros
segments.text: Suspended yung hearing natin. Maraming salamat po mga kasama.

segments.speaker: DENR Acting Secretary Juan Miguel T. Cuna
segments.text: Thank you very much Madam Chair. Thank you very much.
